# Cheat sheet
| Goal | Function |
|---|---|
| create cube | `ocean_cube()` |
| read NetCDF | `read_nc()` |
| materialise | `cube_collect()` |
| select coordinates | `cube_slice()` |
| crop domain | `cube_crop()` |
| extract table/profile/series | `cube_extract()` |
| transect/events | `cube_transect()` / `link_events()` |
| mask | `cube_mask()` |
| recurrent day/month/season climatology | `cube_climatology()` |
| legacy monthly/daily climatology | `clim_month()` / `clim_day()` |
| canonical difference/standard anomaly | `cube_anomaly()` |
| legacy difference/standard anomaly | `anom_diff()` / `anom_z()` |
| legacy standardized anomaly magnitude (`abs(z)`) | `signal_noise()` |
| area/thickness/volume | `cube_cell_area()` / `cube_layer_thickness()` / `cube_cell_volume()` |
| polygon weights | `cube_polygon_weights()` |
| spatial indicators | `spatind` |

Other exports cover Copernicus setup/download, stock context, coast distance,
vertical/annual summaries, and monthly aggregation. See the function cards for
exact signatures.
